title: Single-ring coefficient adjunct and cocycle
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $c=(j,p)$ a compactification, and $\ell\in\mathbf N$. For every map $a:A\to B$ of finite commutative rings annihilated by powers of $\ell$, the canonical proper/open restriction transformation $\operatorname{singleRestriction}(a,c)$ [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data] is an isomorphism. The scalar transpose of $\operatorname{compactScalarMap}(a,c)$ is compact support applied to the source scalar unit followed by its inverse. For a further such map $b:B\to D$, the scalar maps obey $\operatorname{compactScalarMap}(ba,c)=\operatorname{singlePath}(a,b,c)$ with the published balanced scalar associators.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; Zheng Constructions 4.1, 5.14-5.15 and Lemma 5.16. Agent elaboration of Original item proof steps 4, 6-7: single coefficient ring adjunct normalization and coefficient composition.

proof.text: The proper restriction transformation is invertible by the proved scalar_directImage_isIso, and the open restriction comparison is an exact localized isomorphism. Their pasted natural transformation singleRestriction is therefore invertible. Transpose the proper scalar mate using scalar_unit_directImage. For the open factor, the ordinary geometric mate equation localizes to the derived one, and commuting the two mate operations gives the open scalar-unit equation. Paste by naturality and cancel the restriction isomorphism to obtain the stated adjunct formula.

The published finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap is the mate of the same normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism as scalarMate. Rewrite its proved coefficient-chain theorem to obtain the proper scalar coefficient-chain equation, with the published pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp associators.

The open coefficient-chain equation is etaleOpenScalarComparisons.successive_scalar. The open-unit normalization identifies its openScalarExtension with ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso. Naturality of the proper scalar mate pastes the proper and open coefficient-chain equations, giving compactScalarMap(a ≫ b) = singlePath a b c.

theorem etaleSingleCoefficientProjection
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) (l : ℕ) :
    (∀ (A B : CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (_hA : Finite A) (_hB : Finite B)
        (_htA : ∃ m : ℕ, (l ^ m : A) = 0) (_htB : ∃ m : ℕ, (l ^ m : B) = 0)
        (a : A ⟶ B),
        ∃ d : rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c ⋙
            Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology a.hom ≅
          Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology a.hom ⋙
            rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c,
          d.hom = singleRestriction a c ∧
          ∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A X,
            (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
              (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology a.hom)).homEquiv
                _ _ ((compactScalarMap a.hom c).app M) =
              (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).map
                ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
                  (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology a.hom)).unit.app M) ≫
                d.inv.app ((scalarExtension a.hom X).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ (A B D : CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (_hA : Finite A) (_hB : Finite B)
        (_hD : Finite D) (_htA : ∃ m : ℕ, (l ^ m : A) = 0)
        (_htB : ∃ m : ℕ, (l ^ m : B) = 0) (_htD : ∃ m : ℕ, (l ^ m : D) = 0)
        (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D),
        compactScalarMap (a ≫ b).hom c = singlePath a b c)
